unit: 14 cell lines; 28 line-role campaigns; roles are dependent
primary_endpoint: Count of source hit1 AND source hit2 after legal purchased screen and confirmation; not independently thawed culture confirmation
budget: ceil(0.2 * full source menu size), each replayed measurement costs one credit
cost_limit: Credits and round slots are simulated, not measured laboratory money or hours
baseline: prior_control_score, screen fraction 0.7, screen then confirm
selection: Outer leave-one-cell-out. Both roles of the held-out cell excluded. Select a global fraction on other 13 cells; fixed tie order 0.7,0.6,0.8,0.5,0.9. Cached score models remain frozen.

feedback.probe_rule: Greedy drug-feature diversity among top 2*screen_count static candidates
feedback.public_features: Directed anchor and library component identities; secondary target-set overlap from source annotation
feedback.observation: Purchased source raw_y1 only; fitted y1 and unpurchased outcomes never passed to feedback ranker
feedback.raw_reference: Other 13 cells' raw_y1 by tissue and exact dose/role key, with 5 pseudo observations at other-cell tissue mean; exploratory historical lookup
feedback.score: static percentile plus alpha times centered kernel-predicted standardized raw residual
controls: same probes and rounds without update
feedback.confirmation_order: Frozen static score for all feedback arms

uncertainty: Descriptive paired bootstrap by cell, 2000 draws. Conditional on fixed published models; no refit bootstrap, no independent confirmation claim.
negative_controls: Target outcome poisoning cannot alter the public menu or first batch
Changing R2 cannot alter any purchase
Synthetic informative/no-information worlds test harness sensitivity only
do_not: Tune alpha on these target outcomes
Use R2 to train or update any ranker
Count random seeds as biological replicates
Promote best sensitivity-grid result as validated policy
Treat missing raw endpoints as zero
